title: How Vicky McClure Became the Reigning Queen of the British Police Procedural
summary: As one of Britain's most prolific TV actors prepares to detonate season four of ITV's 'Trigger Point,' she opens up about 'Line of Duty' fame, her working-class roots and reminding young creatives that showbiz remains a deeply privileged space: "London should not be the center of the universe. For anything."
